what: Two invocations of FrontierOR's one_shot_eval.py Quick Start path, re-running the pre-generated programs shipped in samples/oneshot_code (no LLM calls) on public instances of the Hugging Face dataset. Every number in examples/output/ comes from these two CSVs plus the public reference rows in gurobi_references_subset.csv.
dataset: SmartOR/FrontierOR (resolves to frontieror/FrontierOR) @ 9f5cd5436f7f4e013dfa81aebea77a1cc98628b8, lastModified 2026-09-28T00:15:24Z; only tasks/{bierwirth2017,liao2020,walteros2020} and metadata/ downloaded

invocations.command: python -u one_shot_eval.py --task-plan-json task_plan_non_gurobi.json --reuse-code all --code-root samples/oneshot_code --exec-mode bare --instance_workers 1 --results_csv eval_results_quickstart.csv
invocations.plan: task_plan_non_gurobi.json: the 11 (paper, model) sample programs that do not import gurobipy, instances tiny + large_1

invocations.command: python -u one_shot_eval.py --task-plan-json task_plan_gurobi_tiny.json --reuse-code all --code-root samples/oneshot_code --exec-mode bare --instance_workers 1 --results_csv eval_results_quickstart_gurobi_tiny.csv
invocations.plan: task_plan_gurobi_tiny.json: the 10 remaining sample programs for these papers (all import gurobipy), tiny only

settings.note: one_shot_eval.py's --time_limit default, applied to tiny and large_1 alike (the Quick Start passes no time flags). The paper's protocol uses 3600 s for large instances, so large_1 here is a shorter budget than the paper's.

environment.gurobipy: 12.0.3 from PyPI, no GRB_LICENSE_FILE (size-limited pip license)

excluded_from_export.reason: runtime_error caused by this environment, not by the programs: the run log shows 'gurobipy._exception.GurobiError: Model too large for size-limited license' for each. The rows stay in the CSV verbatim; export_example.py skips them.

observations: The four non-Gurobi liao2020 samples and two Gurobi-based ones (gemini-3.1-pro-preview, qwen3-coder-plus) are rejected by the dataset's hardened checker: 'missing required solution field(s): c_g, c_o, c_w, cost_structure, model_variables'.
bierwirth2017/deepseek-r1 timed out at 300 s on tiny in this 2-vCPU environment.
